metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2025 · Frankenstein
metas.description: Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.

metas.name: ★ 5.0 · 2026 · Thrash
metas.description: When a Category 5 hurricane decimates a coastal town, the storm surge brings devastation, chaos and something far more frightening: hungry sharks.

metas.name: ★ 5.1 · 2025 · Fear Street: Prom Queen
metas.description: When the "it" girls competing for prom queen at Shadyside High start to disappear, a gutsy outsider discovers she's in for one hell of a prom night.

metas.name: ★ 5.3 · 2025 · The Elixir
metas.description: A dysfunctional family running a renowned herbal medicine business. The owner of the company attempts to innovate by creating a new potion, which ends up triggering a zombie outbreak.

metas.name: ★ 4.9 · 2025 · Ziam
metas.description: In a world succumbing to hunger, a Muay Thai fighter fights off zombies to save his beloved.
